newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Luxembourg OLUX auctions likely to resume in May.
newsitem.headline: Luxembourg OLUX auctions likely to resume in May.

text.p: Luxembourg is likely to resume its linear bond (OLUX) auctions in May, a Luxembourg Treasury official told Reuters on Tuesday.
The Treasury was still awaiting parliamentary approval of a law which authorises the borrowing, meaning a restart in April was unlikely.

The Luxembourg Treasury issues a nominal amount of bonds each year in order to fulfil the Maastricht Treaty criterion on long-term interest rates. At the last auction in October 1996, their bonds were sold at a yield-discount to Germany.
